town_overview.alt: Fly over Futbol Island on your jetpack and see the streets, pitches and beach below.

lesson_field.alt: Watch a play unfold on the pitch while the coach card tells you what to look for.

quiz_question.alt: Answer a quick quiz by tapping the best spot for your teammate on the pitch.

stories_chapter.alt: Read a story chapter with bold pictures and a calm voice about big football feelings.

ball_hunt.alt: Find a hidden ball on the reef and unlock a mini lesson about the rules of the game.

fishing.alt: Cast your line, wait for the splash and spin the reel to land a fish.

fishbook.alt: Flip through your Fishbook to see every fish you caught and a fun football fact for each one.

diving_reef.alt: Dive under the sea and swim around a sunken pitch on a colourful reef.

animal_ride.alt: Hop on a friendly whale shark and ride it through the warm island water.

npc_chat.alt: Chat with an island neighbour and take on a quick football challenge.

npc_bubble.alt: Walk past a neighbour and a thought bubble pops up with a football tip.

books.alt: Open a pop-up book about a football star and turn the pages to see the story come alive.

vending.alt: Pick a card pack from a vending machine and watch a legend card pop out.

museum.alt: Visit the football museum and look at famous trophies and history cases.

player_cards.alt: Turn the pages of your card binder full of football stars and legends.

kit_shop.alt: Design your own jersey and put your name and number on the back.

arcade_room.alt: Glowing arcade cabinets fill a neon room where you walk up to a game and press Play.

strikers.alt: Two teams race around a glowing pitch in a fast arcade football match.

tennis.alt: Kick the ball over the net and win points in Futbol Tennis.

pinball.alt: Flip the football around a pinball table to score big points.

breakaway.alt: Run down a glowing track, dodge tacklers and jump over obstacles on the way to goal.

pass_puzzles.alt: Draw a pass around the defender to find your teammate and solve the puzzle.

beach_match.alt: Watch a sunny five-a-side match on the beach court.

emotes.alt: Pick an emote and do tricks with the ball next to an island neighbour.

scooter_bike.alt: Zoom along the island paths on your own scooter.

save_code.alt: Get a secret save code made of three football words and a number to keep your island safe.

paths_screen.alt: Choose your path: 7v7, 9v9, 11v11 or Futsal, each with its own lessons.

mp_join.alt: Type in your friend's party code and tap Join to play together.

mp_meet.alt: A friend walks over and you both wave hello, with name tags over your heads.

mp_emotes.alt: Give your friend a high five, then dance together.

mp_ball.alt: Kick your ball at a friend and, Bonk!, down they go.

mp_bump.alt: Two friends on bikes ride into each other for a silly bump.

mp_ride.alt: Ride scooters side by side across the island with a friend.

mp_party.alt: Three friends in one party have a dance-off in the plaza.

mp_sidebyside.alt: Two phones, one island: each player sees their friend dance and high-five.

wide_fishing.alt: Wait for the bite, spin the reel and land a mackerel at the beach fishing spot.

wide_diving.alt: Swim through a reef grotto past an old goal and find a starfish on the sea floor.

wide_bugs.alt: On the Summit Isle pitch, sneak up on a ladybug, swing the net and catch the Goalie Ladybug, whose card tells a true goalkeeping story.

wide_jobs.alt: Three island jobs: set a cone on its mark, paint the faded centre circle, then watch an offside replay and keep the flag down.

wide_vending.alt: Zoom onto the plaza vending machine, buy an all-time greats pack and reveal a Marta card.

wide_museum.alt: Walk through the football museum to a case and see the throw-in and the Ballon d’Or up close.

wide_arcade.alt: Launch the ball and flip away on the arcade’s football pinball table as the score climbs.

wide_books.alt: Turn the pages of a pop-up story book about a footballer growing up far from home.

wide_cards.alt: Open a mystery card, Lamine Yamal flies into the binder, then the binder pages turn through the wingers.

wide_npc.alt: Walk up to Mr. Okafor, ask for a quick challenge and choose the kind answer.

wide_multiplayer.alt: Two friends meet on the island, wave hello and high-five.

friend_step1.alt: A grown-up answers a times-table question before online play is switched on.

friend_step2.alt: The party screen shows a short code to share only with friends you know.

montage.alt: One afternoon on Futbol Island: dribble across the town square, scooter along the causeway road, fly a jetpack over the town, ride the zipline to Coral Cay, swim with the rays and explore a reef underwater.

montage_xl.alt: One afternoon on Futbol Island: dribble across the town square, scooter along the causeway road, fly a jetpack over the town, ride the zipline to Coral Cay, swim with the rays and explore a reef underwater.

montage_m.alt: One afternoon on Futbol Island: dribble across the town square, scooter along the causeway road, fly a jetpack over the town, ride the zipline to Coral Cay, swim with the rays and explore a reef underwater.

montage_s.alt: One afternoon on Futbol Island: dribble across the town square, scooter along the causeway road, fly a jetpack over the town, ride the zipline to Coral Cay, swim with the rays and explore a reef underwater.

fuel_konbini.alt: Walk up to the Konbini on Island Square and step inside, stroll past the shelves, then buy a bottle of water and drink it for +25 fuel and a salmon onigiri and eat it for +50 fuel; a banana from the island pocket fills the fuel bar to 100.

town_overview_45.alt: Dribble a ball across the town square and knock over two townspeople with it, ride a scooter over the bridge to Coral Cay, fly along the shore of Summit Isle, then blast up and parachute down over the whole island.

lesson_field_45.alt: The Paths map, a painted story film, a lesson playing on a tilted pitch and a quiz answered on the pitch.

diving_reef_45.alt: Dive under the sea and swim around a sunken pitch on a colourful reef.

save_code_45.alt: Get a secret save code made of three football words and a number to keep your island safe.

mp_join_45.alt: Type in your friend's party code and tap Join to play together.

mp_sidebyside_45.alt: Two phones, one island: each friend sees the other walk over, wave and high-five.

friend_step1_45.alt: A grown-up answers a times-table question before online play is switched on.

friend_step2_45.alt: The party screen shows a short code to share only with friends you know, and a Copy link button.

slide_stories.alt: Watch a play unfold on the lesson pitch, then answer the quiz and see why the right run works.

slide_stories_m.alt: Watch a play unfold on the lesson pitch, then answer the quiz and see why the right run works.

slide_arcade.alt: Dribble, pass and score in Island Strikers, the arcade’s five-a-side football game.

slide_arcade_m.alt: Dribble, pass and score in Island Strikers, the arcade’s five-a-side football game.

slide_beachmatch.alt: Watch a seven-a-side beach match where the keeper dives to save a shot and the rebound is tucked in.

slide_beachmatch_m.alt: Watch a seven-a-side beach match where the keeper dives to save a shot and the rebound is tucked in.

slide_kit.alt: Design a jersey in the studio, paint it, put your name and number on the back, then wear it around town.

slide_kit_m.alt: Design a jersey in the studio, paint it, put your name and number on the back, then wear it around town.

slide_collection.alt: Scroll the Fishbook, where every sea animal links to a real club story, then open a two eras card pack.

slide_collection_m.alt: Scroll the Fishbook, where every sea animal links to a real club story, then open a two eras card pack.

slide_party.alt: Two friends in a party wave, dance, high-five and cheer together on the town square.

slide_party_m.alt: Two friends in a party wave, dance, high-five and cheer together on the town square.

explore_45.alt: Swim round a sunken pitch on the reef, kick a ball at a soccer-wall target to find a hidden ball, then kick one at a mango tree on Summit Isle to drop another and open its mini lesson.
